advisories.detail: The audited Excalidraw v0.18.1 source calls nanoid only with no size or fixed positive integer sizes (40 for file IDs); Clarin never uses these client IDs as authentication, share-link or session secrets. Recheck those call sites on every upstream update.

The vulnerable negative-size non-secure/custom generator precondition is absent: Excalidraw v0.18.1 uses nanoid() and nanoid(40), and Clarin exposes no attacker-controlled size. Keep a source-call-site review and untrusted-scene limits as release gates.

The vulnerable zero-size custom-generator precondition is absent from the audited Excalidraw v0.18.1 call sites. Any new customAlphabet, customRandom or non-positive/dynamic size call is a release blocker pending review.

lodash-es is reachable from the optional Mermaid parser dependency. Clarin removes the Mermaid/AI affordance, does not accept Mermaid as an import format and verifies the production UI/runtime trace; enabling that path makes this advisory a release blocker.

The affected lodash-es path is confined to the disabled Mermaid parser feature. Clarin neither invokes that parser nor maps untrusted scene data into lodash path operations; bundle and browser gates must keep the feature unreachable.

The affected lodash-es path is transitive through the disabled Mermaid parser. Reintroducing Mermaid conversion, AI generation or a generic parser API requires a fixed dependency and a new security review before release.

picomatch is present only through Excalidraw's declared sass -> chokidar -> anymatch install/build-tool chain. It is not imported by the Pizarras browser runtime and receives no user-controlled glob pattern; a new runtime import or untrusted build input reopens this finding.

The ReDoS-affected picomatch version belongs to the sass build-tool branch, not the browser editor path. Clarin builds from trusted repository globs and the production-bundle gate must continue proving this package is absent from the Pizarras runtime chunks.

releaseDecision.reason: The current whole-frontend npm production audit still contains 2 critical and 13 high findings, so an unattended/automatic promotion is forbidden. The Excalidraw-rooted findings have reviewed non-reachability or fixed-input mitigations and do not by themselves forbid a manual feature release.

manualFeatureDecision.reason: No recorded advisory precondition is reachable in the enabled Pizarras paths: Mermaid/AI is removed, nanoid sizes are fixed/default and non-secret, and picomatch is build-only. The release owner must still review and explicitly accept or remediate the inherited whole-frontend baseline before deployment.
